purpose: Teach: アットホーム/ともなっ/見なし/三四郎/インテリジェント/平年/山川/加護

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「アットホームな空気を作るのは家族の力」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho — Dad was saying how creating a warm, family-like atmosphere comes from the strength of family itself.
lines.style: Soft, reflective cadence. Sharing something precious she overheard. Warm regard for both Sho and his father. Gentle pace, like offering a gift of words.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんに「成長をともなって責任も増える」って教えて頂いたよ
lines.en: Mei-sis — Dad taught me that as we grow, our responsibilities grow with us.
lines.style: Clear, sincere delivery. Small voice but steady. The pride of having learned something real. Slight emphasis on the connection between growth and duty, as a child would treasure it.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「君を頼もしいと見なしている」って褒めて下さったわ
lines.en: Sho — Dad was saying he sees you as someone reliable, someone he can count on.
lines.style: Warm and direct. Sharing praise like it's a quiet reassurance. Eye-contact level. The certainty of someone repeating something they want him to know.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと「三四郎の青春」のお話聞いたよ
lines.en: Mei-sis — Dad and I talked about the story of Sanshiro's youth.
lines.style: Eager brightness. Opening with quiet wonder. The delight of sharing something learned. Slight lean forward with enthusiasm, but still respectful of the story's weight.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「インテリジェントな読書習慣を持って」と仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho — Dad was saying you should develop the habit of reading with intention, with real thought behind it.
lines.style: Measured, almost scholarly tone. Repeating something that landed on her—a principle, not just words. Slight pause before the main thought, as if considering its importance.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと平年の桜の開花日を予想したよ
lines.en: Mei-sis — Dad and I guessed what day the cherry blossoms would bloom this year.
lines.style: Bright, almost playful. The joy of a small ritual shared. Simple and direct, like it's both ordinary and special. Soft smile in the voice.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「山川は地球の血管」って詩的に仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho — Dad said something poetic—that mountains and rivers are the earth's own blood vessels.
lines.style: Wondering, almost reverent. The beauty of an unexpected metaphor settling in. Slow delivery to let the image breathe. Slight awe at his father's way with words.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんに「神様の加護を信じて頑張ろう」って言われたよ
lines.en: Mei-sis — Dad told me to have faith in God's protection and to keep doing my best.
lines.style: Soft, steady, and deeply felt. The tenderness of being encouraged. No performance—just the quiet strength of a child receiving a father's blessing. Trails gently at the end.
